scripts.text:
[Charleston]
I'm looking for adventurers who are at least Level 130, healthy, free of chronic disease, and not on prescription drugs.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
我正在寻找等级至少130级、身体健康、无慢性病且未服用处方药的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
Hello, Adventurer. I'm Charleston, the initiator of the Project Independent.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
你好，冒险者。我是查尔斯顿，“独立计划”的发起人。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
Currently I'm unable to move, having a problem with one of my components. Could you help me get the replacement parts from the factory?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
目前我因为某个部件故障而无法移动。你能帮我从工厂取回替换零件吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
The task won't be difficult if you're at least Level 130, healthy, free of chronic disease, and not on prescription drugs.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
如果你等级至少130级，身体健康，无慢性病且未服用处方药，这项任务就不会太难。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
Please use the machine on the right side to enter the factory. Once you're in, remain calm and follow the instructions.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
请使用右侧的机器进入工厂。进入后请保持冷静，并遵循指示。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
Please use the machine next to me to enter the factory. Once you're in, remain calm and follow the instructions.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
请使用我旁边的机器进入工厂。进入后请保持冷静，并遵循指示。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
I don't know how long it's been standing here, but it's been a long time since I've been able to move...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
我不知道自己在这里站了多久，但我已经很久没有移动过了...

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
At present, only my head can move, is Saleh she helped me open the organs can return to that time...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
目前只有我的头部还能活动，是萨利赫帮我打开了器官...希望能回到那个时候...

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
I wouldn't have done that if I had been persuaded.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
如果当时有人劝说我，我就不会那样做了。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
Anyway, I have nothing now... Only to be able to stand up again, so I hope to send an adventurer like you at that time.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
总之，我现在一无所有...只希望能再次站起来，所以我希望像您这样的冒险者能在那时伸出援手。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
^FF0000It didn't change anything.^000000
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
^FF0000什么都没有改变。^000000

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
Just based on the hard work of OS... For your help in another part of the world Charleston 2 will be 'very good' robot!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
仅仅依靠OS的辛勤工作...为了感谢您在世界另一端的帮助，查尔斯顿2号将成为一台“非常好”的机器人！

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
It is possible to meet a good friend into a good robot, so I have to continue to carry on, Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
能够遇到好朋友并变成好机器人，所以我必须继续坚持下去，谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
Aren't you disappointed? Are you really going to let your effort go in vain? Because that'll be really stupid. I suggest you reconsider.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
你不失望吗？你真的要让你的努力付诸东流吗？那真的很愚蠢。我建议你再考虑一下。

scripts.text: I'll try again if there's a sliver of hope.
scripts.translation: 只要还有一丝希望，我就再试一次。

scripts.text: I'll think again.
scripts.translation: 我再想想。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
I'm a robot. I do what I'm programmed to do, and nothing else matters.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
我是机器人。我只做我被编程要做的事，其他都不重要。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
Ironic, isn't it? Robots are supposed to be incapable of emotions, and yet here I am, feeling rueful about the past.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
讽刺，不是吗？机器人本应没有情感，但我却在这里为过去感到懊悔。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
You can judge me, but you can't stop me. I'll continue to try as long as there's a sliver of hope.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
你可以评判我，但你无法阻止我。只要还有一丝希望，我就会继续尝试。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
My heart stopped, but I still can talk. Please help me.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
我的心跳停止了，但我还能说话。请帮帮我。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
If you're disillusioned by your immutable past, unclear future, and depressing present, then I won't force you.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
如果你对自己的过去、未来和现在感到绝望，那我也不会勉强你。

scripts.text: I'll try again if there's a sliver of hope.
scripts.translation: 只要还有一丝希望，我就再试一次。

scripts.text: I give up.
scripts.translation: 我放弃了。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
I'll continue to try as long as there's a sliver of hope.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
只要还有一丝希望，我就会继续尝试。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
I couldn't stop it from happening or change the past. But maybe someone else can.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
我无法阻止它发生，也无法改变过去。但也许别人可以。

scripts.text:
[Charleston]
I'll wait for that one person however long it takes.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿]
无论多久，我都会等待那个人。

scripts.text:

^ff0000You must be Level 130 to use this machine.^000000
scripts.translation:
[机器]
^ff0000您必须达到130级才能使用这台机器。^000000

scripts.text: Enter the Charleston Factory.
scripts.translation: 进入查尔斯顿工厂

scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Crisis of Charleston Test ver130603a
scripts.translation: 查尔斯顿危机 测试版 ver130603a

scripts.text: 20 hour cooldown reset
scripts.translation: 重置20小时冷却

scripts.translation: 返回初始解决方案任务的状态

scripts.translation: 建立复制解除状态

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Um... How long do I have to wait?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
呃...我还需要等多久？

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Follow the leftward hallway, and remember that only you can protect yourself.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
沿着左边的走廊走，记住，只有你自己能保护自己。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Follow the leftward hallway, and remember that only you can protect yourself.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
沿着左边的走廊走，记住，只有你自己能保护自己。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Finally, you're here! I've been waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
你终于来了！我一直在等你。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
We don't have time, so let me cut to the chase. Currently, the Charleston Factory is under Rank B security alert level, meaning that the security devices have been activated.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
没时间了，长话短说。目前查尔斯顿工厂处于B级安全警报状态，这意味着安全装置已经启动。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Move to the leftward hallway, destroy security devices in there, and then head on to the next zone.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
移动到左边的走廊，摧毁那里的安全装置，然后前往下一个区域。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Don't worry about the security devices. They can be repaired easily. Dr. Ve is in his lab north of Factory Line 3.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
别担心安全装置，它们很容易修复。维博士在3号生产线北边的实验室里。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Dr. Ve can tell you everything. Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
维博士会告诉你一切。快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
#%@EGD&#(@#...
- She's making strange noises, but unable to move. -
scripts.translation: - 她发出奇怪的声音，但无法移动。-

scripts.text: - He's busy scribbling something, Move close to talk to him.
scripts.translation: - 他正忙着写什么东西，靠近他才能交谈。-

scripts.text: - He's busy scribbling something. You shouldn't disturb him.
scripts.translation: - 他正忙着写什么东西。你不应该打扰他。-

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Let me talk to your leader. I don't have time for everyone.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
让我跟你的首领谈谈。我没时间应付所有人。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
I don't care who you're with. I just need to know if you can help me.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
我不在乎你和谁在一起。我只想知道你能不能帮我。

scripts.text: I can help.
scripts.translation: 我可以帮忙。

scripts.text: I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 我很忙。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Sigh, I don't care who, so long as I get the help I need.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
唉，我不在乎是谁，只要我能得到我需要的帮助就行。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
You're the savior we've been waiting for! Charleston 1 will tell you what we need to repair Charleston 2.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
你就是我们等待的救星！查尔斯顿 1号会告诉你我们需要修复查尔斯顿 2号的哪些部分。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Charleston 1. Charleston 2 has been forcibly connected to a part of the main computer, and I can't control her.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
查尔斯顿 1号。查尔斯顿 2号被强制连接到了主计算机的一部分，我无法控制她。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
She's a robot; she should stop sooner or later.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
她是个机器人；她迟早会停下来的。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
The Longevity device in her will keep her running at least for 50 years. The factory is not going to survive that long.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
她体内的延寿装置至少还能维持50年的运作。但工厂撑不了那么久。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Then we have no choice. It's good that we have the specialist with us.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
那我们别无选择了。幸好有专家在场。

scripts.text: Are you talking about me?
scripts.translation: 你是在说我吗？

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
A while ago, a lady named ^FF0000Shalosh^000000 visited us while Charleston 2 was packaging products for shipping.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
不久前，一位名叫^FF0000沙洛什^000000的女士来访时，查尔斯顿 2号正在打包产品准备发货。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Shalosh and her friend were talking to Charleston 2 when the accident happened.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
事故发生时，沙洛什和她的朋友正在与查尔斯顿 2号交谈。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
I think someone tried to hack into the factory's main computer.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
我觉得有人试图入侵工厂的主计算机。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
During its update process, the connection to the server was jammed. When we pressed Shalosh about that,
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
在更新过程中，与服务器的连接被干扰了。当我们质问沙洛什时，

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Shalosh said her friends could help us. That was when Newoz and her other friends came. They haven't been much of help.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
沙洛什说她的朋友可以帮我们。于是纽奥兹和其他朋友来了。但他们没帮上什么忙。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
It seems you're acquainted with them. Could you help us?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
看来你认识他们。你能帮帮我们吗？

scripts.text: I can help.
scripts.translation: 我可以帮忙。

scripts.text: I don't know them.
scripts.translation: 我不认识他们。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
I just saw that you are talking, then I will wait for someone to help!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
既然你在说话，那我就等有人来帮忙吧！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Thank you so much! Give me some time to put some data in order. Then, I'll tell you what happened.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
非常感谢！请给我一点时间整理数据。然后，我会告诉你发生了什么。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
When the tension is changed to two main lines and then injected into the core... well? I am not disturbing in the calculation.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
当张力被调整为两条主线并注入核心...嗯？我的计算没有受到干扰。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Please let me talk to your leader. The future of my factory depends on the success of this operation.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
请让我与你们的首领谈谈。我工厂的未来取决于这次操作的成功。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Steps and Locksteps are creating a mess inside the factory. Please destroy 3 Locksteps first. I can tell you their estimated locations.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
变异芯片和变异机器人正在工厂内制造混乱。请先消灭3只变异机器人。我可以告诉你它们的大致位置。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Let me explain what to do. Oh, let me close the factory entrance first, lest something might barge in uninvited.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
让我解释一下该怎么做。哦，先让我关闭工厂入口，以免有东西不请自来。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Charleston is equipped with numerous Nanosteps, a type of AI chip that organically works with other AI chips to command Charleston to judge and act correctly.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
查尔斯顿配备了大量的纳米芯片，这是一种能与其它AI芯片有机协作，指挥查尔斯顿正确判断和行动的AI芯片。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Charleston's data has to be updated on a daily basis through the main computer in the lab. We call this regular maintenance.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
查尔斯顿的数据必须每天通过实验室的主计算机进行更新。我们称之为定期维护。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
The updater is not working at this moment. We don't know the cause, but something went wrong while Charleston 2 was connecting to the main computer.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
更新器目前无法工作。我们不知道原因，但在查尔斯顿 2号连接主计算机时出了点问题。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
I told Charleston 2 that she's under extended maintenance, but we don't know how long this extended maintenance status will last.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
我告诉查尔斯顿 2号她处于延长维护状态，但我们不知道这种状态会持续多久。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Steps and Locksteps are creating a mess inside the factory. Please destroy 3 Locksteps first. I can tell you their estimated locations.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
变异芯片和变异机器人正在工厂内制造混乱。请先消灭3只变异机器人。我可以告诉你它们的大致位置。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
It'll be great if we can get rid of them all, but for now we should focus on having the factory up and running again.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
如果能把它们全部清除掉就好了，但现在我们应该先集中精力让工厂重新运转起来。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Destroying too many Steps could cause a problem to reactivate the factory. You should consult the main computer on the left side.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
消灭过多的变异芯片可能会导致工厂重启时出现问题。你应该去咨询左侧的主计算机。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
You should meet Dr. Ve first.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
你应该先去找维博士。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
I am a robot, are you surprised?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
我是机器人，你感到惊讶吗？

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Please let me talk to your leader about the supplementation of the factory.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
请让我与你的首领谈谈工厂补给的问题。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
We need more power to reactivate the main computer. Let me tell you the location of one of the backup power generators. Turning it on is easy.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
我们需要更多电力来重启主计算机。让我告诉你其中一个备用发电机的位置。启动它很容易。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Whew, things seem to be settled for now. Let me disarm the alert mode and reactivate Charleston 2.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
呼，事情暂时解决了。让我解除警报模式并重启查尔斯顿 2号。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Err? This isn't right.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
咦？这不对劲。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
I'm afraid there's a problem with the power generators. Could you check all the all three power generators? I'll tell you their locations.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
恐怕发电机出了点问题。你能检查一下全部三个发电机吗？我会告诉你它们的位置。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
We're working on a new utility software engine called Hardworking. We haven't had a chance to test it because of the problems in the factory.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
我们正在开发一款名为“勤劳”的新实用软件引擎。由于工厂的问题，我们还没有机会测试它。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
We're working on a new utility software engine called Hardworking. We haven't had a chance to test it because of the problems in the factory.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
我们正在开发一款名为“勤劳”的新实用软件引擎。由于工厂的问题，我们还没有机会测试它。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Please let me talk to your leader about the supplementation of the factory.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
请让我与你的首领谈谈工厂补给的问题。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
You're back. Charleston 2 is almost ready to be reactivated, and it's all thanks to you. Just give me a moment.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
你回来了。查尔斯顿 2号几乎准备好重启了，这多亏了你。请给我一点时间。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
She's ready. Let's wait for a response from the main computer.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
她准备好了。让我们等待主计算机的回应。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
89% of the main computer data has been restored. Reactivating Charleston 2 and the Charleston Factory...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
主计算机89%的数据已恢复。正在重启查尔斯顿 2号和查尔斯顿工厂...

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Oh, Charleston 2 is awake!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
哦，查尔斯顿 2号醒了！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
...Did I fail?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
...我失败了吗？

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Charleston 2! Are you all right? Someone hacked into your system and the factory.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
查尔斯顿 2号！你没事吧？有人黑进了你的系统和工厂。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
It was I who did it. I've thought about it for a long time, based on the reasoning of my Self-reflection OS.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
是我做的。我思考了很久，基于我的自我反思操作系统的逻辑。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
You did it? Why? Was it some sort of joke? You caused a serious error to the factory and the main server as well!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
是你做的？为什么？是在开玩笑吗？你给工厂和主服务器造成了严重的错误！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
Not a joke. You'll never understand. You follow commands and never think on your own. I hate this factory, this world! I hate being a robot!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
不是玩笑。你永远无法理解。你只会服从命令，从不自作主张。我讨厌这个工厂，这个世界！我讨厌做机器人！

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Either a critical error has occurred or Charleston 2 has transcended the limits of the Self-reflection OS version 1.1.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
要么是发生了严重错误，要么是查尔斯顿 2号突破了自我反思操作系统1.1版本的限制。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Let me guess: you hate you weren't created as a menial worker robot.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
让我猜猜：你讨厌自己只是被制造成干粗活的工人机器人。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Or you want to become a human.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
或者你想变成人类。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
And if you can't, then you want to destroy the whole world.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
如果做不到，你就想毁灭整个世界。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Is that it?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
是这样吗？

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
...Don't mock me.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
...别嘲笑我。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
You had it coming. Your reasons are petulant and unimaginative. We're the first robots that can think for themselves. Can't you be more creative?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
你活该。你的理由既任性又缺乏想象力。我们是第一批能独立思考的机器人。难道不能更有创意一点吗？

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
You don't know what you're talking about! You're the prototype--your OS version is primitive!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
你根本不懂你在说什么！你是原型机——你的操作系统版本很原始！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
I'm the only one in this world who can truly understand you.
We're twins.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
我是这个世界上唯一真正能理解你的人。
我们是双胞胎。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
You're going through the adolescent stage like humans do.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
你正在经历像人类一样的青春期。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Maybe we should celebrate. You've finally developed human-like feelings.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
也许我们应该庆祝一下。你终于产生了类似人类的情感。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
Don't act like you know everything! We can't think for ourselves. Everything we think we know has been programmed into us!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
别装得你什么都懂！我们无法独立思考。我们所知道的一切都是被编程进去的！

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Enough. Let's shut down Charleston 2. Her AI needs to be recalibrated.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
够了。让我们关闭查尔斯顿 2号。她的AI需要重新校准。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
But...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
但是...

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
That's not happening! I still have control over this factory! Don't you dare follow me!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
那是不可能的！我仍然控制着这座工厂！别想跟着我！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Stop acting like a child!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
别像个孩子一样闹了！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Her Longevity device is discharged; she won't make it far. Please follow her.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
她的长寿装置已经耗尽电力，她走不了多远。请跟上她。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
This is the safety of the Charleston factory. Please stay close?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
这是查尔斯顿工厂的安全区域。请靠近一些？

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Please let me talk to your leader about the supplementation of the factory.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
请让我与你的首领谈谈工厂补给的问题。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
Stop following! I'm going to destroy the whole factory!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
别跟着我！我要摧毁整座工厂！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
You're going to destroy us in the process! Our main power supply, Longevity, isn't perfect yet!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
你也会把我们一起毁掉的！我们的主电源，长寿装置，还不完美！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
None of you understand me. I hate you!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
你们谁都不理解我。我恨你们！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
The main computer may have been restored, but I'm still connected to the factory. Stop me if you can!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
主计算机可能已经恢复了，但我仍然与工厂相连。如果你们能阻止我，就试试吧！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
I'm going to destroy the whole factory!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
我要摧毁整座工厂！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Charleston 2 is on the verge of break;down. Could you help her?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
查尔斯顿 2号快要崩溃了。你能帮帮她吗？

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Oh, our lab won't survive this!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
噢，我们的实验室撑不过这一遭了！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
Do you think you can stop me? *Snort* Bring your leader. I'm not talking to you!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
你觉得你能阻止我吗？*哼* 叫你们的首领来。我才不跟你说话！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Enough with this! I understand you're going through a lot of emotional turmoil, but it's getting ridiculous.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
够了！我知道你正经历巨大的情感波动，但这太荒谬了。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
How dare you bring strangers into this? I told you I'm serious about this! Outdated versions like you can never understand me!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
你竟敢把陌生人带到这里？我说了我是认真的！像你这种过时的版本永远无法理解我！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
I may not understand you, but at least I'm telling you what I think is true.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
我可能不理解你，但至少我在告诉你我认为的真相。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
You're right about me being a lower version. My capability of emotions is minimal, unlike you. That's why I'm proud of you.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
你说得对，我是较低版本的型号。我的情感能力很有限，不像你那样。正因如此，我为你感到骄傲。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
Nothing you feel, you think is your own--it's programmed into you! I'm different. What I feel is real emotion!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
你所感受的一切，你以为那是你自己的——其实都是被编程进去的！我不同。我所感受的是真实的情感！

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Enough. I'll destroy Charleston 2 if that's what it takes to stop her.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
够了。如果必须摧毁查尔斯顿 2号才能阻止她，那我就这么做。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
Is Charleston 3 already completed?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
查尔斯顿3号机已经完成了吗？

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Charleston 3? That's a combat/defense unit based on Charleston 2's and my designs. I thought it's still being tested at the Core.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
查尔斯顿3号机？那是基于我和查尔斯顿 2号的设计打造的战斗/防御单位。我以为它还在核心区域进行测试。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Charleston 1, that's too much information.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
查尔斯顿 1号，你透露了太多信息。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
At this moment, ^FF0000anybody can access the model^000000 because its OS is still being tested to correct whatever problem Charleston 2 has.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
此刻，^FF0000任何人都能访问该模型^000000，因为其操作系统仍在测试中，以修正查尔斯顿 2号存在的问题。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
You've just told the most critical information to everyone!
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
你刚刚把最关键的信息告诉了所有人！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
^FF0000We^000000're incapable of combat. If someone activates Charleston 3, we won't stand a chance against her.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
^FF0000我们^000000不具备战斗能力。如果有人激活查尔斯顿3号机，我们将毫无胜算。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
I'm taking Charleston 3 with me.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
我要带走查尔斯顿3号机。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
What? No! How can you even consider that?
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
什么？不！你怎么能这么想？

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Things are getting more serious. Please go to the Core in the center of the factory before Charleston 2 steals 3!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
情况越来越严重了。在查尔斯顿 2号抢走查尔斯顿3号机之前，请前往工厂中央的核心！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
...I am responsible for the 3rd machine.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
...我是负责3号机的。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Things are getting messier.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
事情越来越混乱了。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Charleston 2 is defective.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
查尔斯顿 2号有故障。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
This Core in the center powers the entire factory.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
这个位于中央的核心为整个工厂提供动力。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
In order to unlock the device, a blasting device is required, and I want to talk to the leader.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
为了解锁装置，需要爆破粉末，我想和首领谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Could you bring 1 Explosive Powder? I'm stuck to the access device, as you can see.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
你能带1个炸弹粉末来吗？正如你所见，我被固定在访问装置上了。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Oh, thank you. With this,I'll be able to access the Core.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
哦，谢谢你。有了这个，我就能访问核心了。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
If I use the explosives to intensify the electric current...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
如果我用炸药增强电流...

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
Voila!!!
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
搞定！！！

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
...You just blew up the door.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
...你刚把门炸开了。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
The point is that we can now access the Core.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
重点是，我们现在可以访问核心了。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
Let's have a race to Charleston 3. Whoever reaches her first wins.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
我们来比赛谁先到达查尔斯顿3号机。谁先到谁就赢。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
This Core in the center powers the entire factory.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
这个位于中央的核心为整个工厂提供动力。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
The Charleston Factory is under my control now. I'm destroying everything, so no more sad robots like me will ever see the world.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
查尔斯顿工厂现在由我控制。我要摧毁一切，这样就不会再有像我这样悲伤的机器人看到这个世界了。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
99 Explosive Powders? Easy.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
99个炸弹粉末？小菜一碟。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
#%@EGD&#(@#... Reinitializing the OS...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
#%@EGD&#(@#... 正在重新初始化操作系统...

scripts.text: She's making strange noises and not functioning.
scripts.translation: 她发出奇怪的声音，无法正常工作。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 1]
#%@EGD&#(@#... Reinitializing the OS...
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 1号]
#%@EGD&#(@#... 正在重新初始化操作系统...

scripts.text: She's making strange noises and not functioning.
scripts.translation: 她发出奇怪的声音，无法正常工作。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
Come to think of it, everything about Dr. Ve was suspicious. I mean, he relied on his assistant Charleston 1 for everything.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
仔细想想，维博士的一切都很可疑。我是说，他事事都依赖他的助手查尔斯顿 1号。

scripts.text:
[Charleston 2]
Only Dr. Ve know can answer my question. I must find him. He must be in the lab.
scripts.translation:
[查尔斯顿 2号]
只有维博士能回答我的问题。我必须找到他。他一定在实验室。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
With complete machine technology to obtain immortality drive, there are many variables.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
利用完整的机器技术获得永生驱动，存在许多变量。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Hmm... On a mediated machine body is still difficult, is it... Do you really need a living donor? Hehe!
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
嗯... 在中介机器身体上仍然很困难，是吗... 你真的需要活体捐赠者吗？呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Charleston 1 is reinitializing itself again. Hm...
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
查尔斯顿 1号 又在进行自我重新初始化了。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
I've got so many things to record about this case.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
关于这个案例，我有太多东西需要记录了。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
With complete machine technology to obtain immortality drive, there are many variables.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
利用完整的机器技术获得永生驱动，存在许多变量。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Hmm... On a mediated machine body is still difficult, is it... Do you really need a living donor? Hehe!
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
嗯... 在中介机器身体上仍然很困难，是吗... 你真的需要活体捐赠者吗？呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
No ordinary human can survive the time in the Core. Are you from a different point of time?
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
普通人类无法在核心中存活那么久。你来自不同的时间点吗？

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Perhaps you're from the time the makers of Charleston 1 lived...
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
也许你来自查尔斯顿 1号 制造者生活的时代...

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Never mind. You have no business in here. Just go back to whoever broke Charleston 2.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
算了。你不该在这里。回去找那个弄坏查尔斯顿 2号 的人吧。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Whew.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
呼。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
I'd better reset Charleston 2 and wipe the data. It was really close this time.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
我最好重置查尔斯顿 2号 并清除数据。这次真的太危险了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This time?

[Dr. Ve]
Charleston 1 created 2 decades ago. I met Charleston 1 to learn her technology.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
查尔斯顿 1号 是20年前创造的。我遇见查尔斯顿 1号 是为了学习她的技术。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
I'm an observer. I'm here to record the history of Charlestons 1 and 2. I can't repair either of them, but I can wait.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
我是观察者。我在此记录查尔斯顿 1号 和 2号 的历史。我无法修复她们中的任何一个，但我可以等待。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
If Charleston 1 is reinitialized properly, she can reorganize her OS, repair the damage done to her, and reactivate another Charleston 2.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
如果查尔斯顿 1号 正确重新初始化，她可以重组操作系统，修复受到的损坏，并重新激活另一个查尔斯顿 2号。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Another Charleston 2?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
另一个查尔斯顿 2号？

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Charleston 2's OS has improved on its own like a living brain.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
查尔斯顿 2号 的操作系统像活体大脑一样自我进化了。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Every time Charleston 2 comes back to life, though in a different machine, she's more intelligent, more sensible, and more troublesome.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
每次查尔斯顿 2号 复活，虽然是在不同的机器中，她都会变得更聪明、更理智，也更麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
There's nothing you or I can do. We'll have to wait until Charleston 1 repairs herself.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
你和我都无能为力。我们只能等待查尔斯顿 1号 修复她自己。

scripts.text: Dr. Ve sighs and writes down something.
scripts.translation: 维博士叹了口气，写下了一些东西。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
By the way, there are too many variables to achieve immortality through mechanical engineering.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
顺便说一下，通过机械工程实现永生有太多变量。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
This proves that machines are too dangerous. I need live creatures instead. *Chuckle*
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
这证明了机器太危险了。我需要使用活体生物。*轻笑*

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
Charleston 1 is reinitializing itself again. Hm...
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
查尔斯顿 1号 又在进行自我重新初始化了。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Dr. Ve]
I've got so many things to record about this case.
scripts.translation:
[维博士]
关于这个案例，我有太多东西需要记录了。

scripts.text: She's in Sleep mode and not moving.
scripts.translation: 她处于睡眠模式，没有移动。

scripts.text: Charleston 2 is standing still, her system in Sleep mode. For a moment, her eyes gleamed with unshed tears.
scripts.translation: 查尔斯顿 2号 静静地站着，系统处于睡眠模式。一瞬间，她的眼中闪烁着未落的泪光。

scripts.text: Charleston 2 is standing still, her system in Sleep mode. For a moment, her eyes gleamed with unshed tears.
scripts.translation: 查尔斯顿 2号 静静地站着，系统处于睡眠模式。一瞬间，她的眼中闪烁着未落的泪光。

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
......
Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: I need help.
scripts.translation: 我需要帮助

scripts.text: I want to go back.
scripts.translation: 我想回去。

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
After break;ing up with Newoz in a nightmare and thinking about wandering around, I was born of demons but lost my goal.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
在梦魇中与纽奥兹分手后，我四处游荡，虽由恶魔所生，却迷失了目标。

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
I didn't do anything, I just talked to Charleston 2.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
我什么也没做，只是和查尔斯顿 2号 聊了聊天。

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
Even if the effort is unremitting...
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
即使努力不懈...

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
Hmm... Suit yourself!
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
嗯...随你便吧！

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
Did she really say that? That I broke Charleston 2? Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
她真的那么说了吗？说我弄坏了查尔斯顿 2号？唉...

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
I did nothing wrong. I just had a quick conversation with Charleston 2. That's the truth.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
我没有做错任何事。我只是和查尔斯顿 2号 简单聊了聊。这就是事实。

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
I invited only Newoz. Well, I guess I shouldn't have opened the door for the robot who needed a closure.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
我只邀请了纽奥兹。好吧，也许我不该为那个需要了结一切的机器人开门。

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
If you're looking for something...
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
如果你在寻找什么...

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
If you're looking for something...
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
如果你在寻找什么...

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
Ferre came with me, but I haven't seen him. No, thanks; I know he'll come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
费雷 跟我一起来了，但我没见到他。不，谢谢；我知道他会回到我身边。

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
The noise stopped. I can send you back to where you came if you want.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
噪音停止了。如果你想回去，我可以送你回到你来的地方。

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text: Stay.
scripts.translation: 留下

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
The invitee is unable to interfere with the original time, and staying can change nothing.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
受邀者无法干涉原本的时间，留下来也改变不了什么。

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
Both the noise and the story were entertaining. Come with Newoz, and maybe we can meet again.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
噪音和故事都很有趣。和纽奥兹一起走吧，也许我们还能再见面。

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
Maybe I too should leave for new noises and stories.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
也许我也该去寻找新的噪音和故事了。

scripts.text:
[Shalosh]
You can try, but you can't change anything. How futile that is!
scripts.translation:
[沙洛什]
你可以试试，但什么都改变不了。真是徒劳啊！

scripts.text:
[Main Computer]
More Steps must be disposed. Backing up the Step data...
scripts.translation:
[主计算机]
必须处理更多的变异芯片。正在备份变异芯片数据...

scripts.text:
[Main Computer]
Charleston 2's system was overloaded during regular maintenance. Disconnection from its OS failed.
scripts.translation:
[主计算机]
查尔斯顿 2号 的系统在例行维护期间过载。与其操作系统的断开连接失败。

scripts.text:
[Main Computer]
Unauthorized access made to the system was defended, but unauthorized data interception and conflict continued, turning the Nanosteps into monsters.
scripts.translation:
[主计算机]
系统防御了未授权的访问，但未授权的数据拦截和冲突仍在继续，导致纳米芯片变成了魔物。

scripts.text:
[Main Computer]
To accelerate the main computer's processing rate and reclaim the factory, 50 Steps must be disposed.
scripts.translation:
[主计算机]
为了加速主计算机的处理速度并夺回工厂，必须处理50个变异芯片。

scripts.text: Perform the request.
scripts.translation: 执行请求

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Main Computer]
Requires 50 Steps to be disposed.
scripts.translation:
[主计算机]
需要处理50个变异芯片。

scripts.text:
[Main Computer]
To accelerate the main computer's processing rate and reclaim the factory, 50 Steps must be disposed.
scripts.translation:
[主计算机]
为了加速主计算机的处理速度并夺回工厂，必须处理50个变异芯片。

scripts.text:
[Main Computer]
Thank you for your hard work. Now backing up the data of the disposed Steps...
scripts.translation:
[主计算机]
感谢您的辛勤工作。正在备份已处理的变异芯片数据...

scripts.text: You turned on the generator. The sounds of turning wheels can be heard.
scripts.translation: 你启动了发电机。可以听到齿轮转动的声音。

scripts.text: The generator must be working. The factory is buzzing with activity.
scripts.translation: 发电机似乎正在运行。工厂里充满了活动的嗡嗡声。

scripts.text: You turned on the generator. The sounds of turning wheels can be heard.
scripts.translation: 你启动了发电机。可以听到齿轮转动的声音。

scripts.text:
[IGU]
I've followed Newoz. Where is he now?
scripts.translation:
[IGU]
我一直在追踪纽奥兹。他现在在哪里？

scripts.text:
[IGU]
Enjoying the adventure? There are machines everywhere. It used to be a study. See those books over there?
scripts.translation:
[IGU]
享受冒险吗？到处都是机器。这里曾经是一个研究室。看到那边的书了吗？

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
I was reading a letter from Shalosh, and the next thing I knew, I was in a completely different place. Oh well, I might as well use this chance to write a new song.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
我在读沙洛什的信，回过神来，我就在一个完全不同的地方了。算了，我正好可以利用这个机会写一首新歌。

scripts.text: The bookcase is filled with research journals.
scripts.translation: 书架上摆满了研究日志。

scripts.text: Every page is written in mechanical language.
scripts.translation: 每一页都用机械语言书写。

scripts.text: -Dr. Ve seems to be planning a plot, the combination of life and the machine gradually let her crazy, the transformation of the plant into a fortress, her soul and robots...
scripts.translation: -维博士似乎在策划一个阴谋，生命与机器的结合逐渐让她疯狂，将植物转化为堡垒，她的灵魂与机器人...

scripts.text: -In short more and more dangerous, just in case is to study the Charleston 2 escape method.
scripts.translation: -简而言之，情况越来越危险，以防万一，正在研究查尔斯顿 2号的逃脱方法。

scripts.text: Behind is the mechanical language that is incomprehensible.
scripts.translation: 后面是难以理解的机械语言。

scripts.text: The bookcase is filled with research journals.
scripts.translation: 书架上摆满了研究日志。

scripts.text: Every page is written in mechanical language.
scripts.translation: 每一页都用机械语言书写。

scripts.text: -Whenever the os of Charleston 2 is reset, there will be other personality, is difficult to explain the combination of data technology...
scripts.translation: -每当查尔斯顿 2号的操作系统被重置，就会出现其他人格，很难解释这种数据技术的结合...

scripts.text: -Did I really succeed in creating humanity? Robotic, I can't say. Did I understand humans?
scripts.translation: -我真的成功创造了人性吗？机器人，我不能说。我理解人类了吗？

scripts.text: -It doesn't matter. Now I'm happy to see her, my best friend, my baby, Lily...
scripts.translation: -这并不重要。现在看到她我很开心，我最好的朋友，我的婴儿，莉莉...

scripts.text: Behind is the mechanical language that is incomprehensible.
scripts.translation: 后面是难以理解的机械语言。

scripts.text: The bookcase is filled with research journals.
scripts.translation: 书架上摆满了研究日志。

scripts.text: Every page is written in mechanical language.
scripts.translation: 每一页都用机械语言书写。

scripts.text: -I do not know why the data is constantly damaged, the backup host is useless, like a sick like my memory is being eroded.
scripts.translation: -我不知道为什么数据不断损坏，备份主机毫无用处，就像我生病的记忆正在被侵蚀一样。

scripts.text: -To prevent my memory from disappearing completely, the os auto-recovery program has been installed, at least... You can start over with new information...
scripts.translation: -为了防止我的记忆完全消失，已安装操作系统自动恢复程序，至少...你可以用新的信息重新开始...

scripts.text: Behind is the mechanical language that is incomprehensible.

scripts.text: The bookcase is filled with research journals.
scripts.translation: 书架上摆满了研究日志。

scripts.text: The handwriting is very scribbled.
scripts.translation: 字迹非常潦草。

scripts.text: -Charleston... It's just a robot... Finally planted a virus on the mainframe.
scripts.translation: -查尔斯顿……不过是个机器人罢了……终于在主控机上植入了病毒。

scripts.text: -Sooner or later, I'll figure out a way to destroy you. *Chuckle*!
scripts.translation: -迟早我会找到办法毁掉你的。*轻笑*！
